name: Kusaka Yuuma
source:
The protagonist of the story. He is a second-year student at Silverseal Private Academy and the treasurer of the student council who excels at math.

He cares about his little sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c139081]Yuno[/url], more than anyone else.
